description.value:
Magitech runes etch onto the weapon's muzzle, guiding the trajectory of your shots unerringly to your target. For the duration, you can make ranged Strikes against creatures that have total cover from you using the target weapon, as long as the creature is within your weapon's first range increment, you're aware of the creature, and you can draw an unbroken path between yourself and the creature. This path doesn't need to be a straight line, and the creature has greater cover against such Strikes. The distance between yourself and the creature you attack is calculated based on the length of the drawn path.

Heightened (+2) Increase the maximum distance from which you can target a creature by one range increment.
